todo_list.content: Read original sources and record selected Story targets
todo_list.active_form: Reading source evidence and target baselines
instructions: Load ceaia-sdlc-story-spec-generation and its workflow-contract plus shared quality standard. This is the JSON-first route; platform runtime is GPT-5.6 Luna or GPT-6 Luna, with no scripts or unconfirmed model parameters in this Task.

Keep complete SDLC intent unless explicitly preparation-only/no-Jira or stopped. Classify new_story versus existing_ticket_update and confirm each Jira source before reads; never infer from a key or turn an update into create. Save original Description, separate AC result and complete readJiraAttachments inventory for updates, plus actual available target facts.

Retain every selected candidate as ready or precisely blocked. Intake classification can complete with pending targets recorded so unrelated ready candidates can proceed. Assign batch-unique source requirement IDs; a shortened register never replaces original evidence.
completion_criteria: Selected target/source identities, original evidence and per-target ready/waiting causes are recorded without silently dropping scope.

todo_list.content: Assemble final Story JSON, review and score each ready candidate
todo_list.active_form: Querying fields, generating JSON/SPEC and recording actual scores
instructions: For each ready candidate read generation jira-json-assembly.md now. Reuse matching user profiles, or queryJiraProjectsByName/queryJiraIssueTypesByProject/queryJiraCreateMetaFields only for missing supported routing/schema facts. Resolve actual project/Story type/required values and approved attachment intent during generation, before final scoring. Save confirmed field/schema evidence in its assembly record; do not postpone payload assembly or rendering to export.

Read Q1-Q7 before writing. Use the confirmed fields JSON structure: real root staffId, jiraInstance, projectKey and issueType, fields.project.key equals root projectKey, fields.issuetype.id equals the queried Story type ID, reporter.name uses real staffId for create, and fields.summary/description are strings. Resolve customFields.acceptanceCriteria to the actual metadata-confirmed ID and store AC Markdown in fields[that ID]. No top-level summary/description/acceptanceCriteria/bddScenarios, screenshot IDs or description arrays. Save the complete actual story.json4jira, then derive executable TEST_CASE.md and every named SPEC business projection from those actual field values. Perform one production precheck; JSON, AC/BDD meaning and SPEC/tests must align. Updates retain approved omission/preservation semantics.

Invoke a fresh read-only ceaia-spec-review with originals, actual JSON, tests, all SPECs and field interpretation evidence. Parent saves the numbered report and follows the shared bounded repair/clarification rules. Reviewer does not score, edit or write Jira. Continue independent preparation of other ready candidates while preserving blocked scope.

After content PASS synchronize/read back all SPEC Result/Reviewer Notes before scoring. Actually call nodejs-base-mcp.scoreUserStory with exactly story_json_workspace_path, specFileStatus=Pass, specFilePath. Use the real saved JSON path and primary SPEC path; save/read back the complete response and actual input/revision binding. Retain 76-100 numeric/ok/parser policy and handle validation-failed strings or SKIPPED without inventing score PASS.

Keep Story score only in the independent result/UI, never write it into SPEC or JSON. Freeze current JSON/SPECs after scoring; no display-driven S2. Any later JSON or scored SPEC edit requires a current package score and affected review. Do not force unchanged rescoring or fabricate business facts. Unverified update/replace schema handling is a specific WAITING_TOOL, never permission to call a create-shaped package.
completion_criteria: Every selected candidate has current complete JSON/assembly, independent content PASS and a passing persisted JSON+SPEC assessment, or its scope was explicitly changed/stopped. Pending candidates prevent full stage completion but not unrelated preparation.
Current source/review/score records and consumed repair state are retained. There is no Jira write or legacy five-field call in this stage.

todo_list.content: Reconcile selected scope and obtain current upload-content confirmation
todo_list.active_form: Checking global coverage and presenting scored JSON previews
instructions: Reconcile original in-scope obligations with every selected current candidate, supported exclusions and pending items in actual batchStatePath. Require zero pending obligations and current evidence-revision bindings before integrated export. Do not silently omit blocked candidates or change scope.

Verify current review/score/JSON/SPEC/assembly evidence without rerunning unchanged tools, then set parent jiraReady/updateReady only where applicable. Preparation-only ends here with actual artifacts and score results, without Jira success.

For export intent, use exporter handoff and preview procedure to present the actual scored .json4jira content and attachments in the platform preview. Obtain explicit user confirmation bound to the current JSON path/revision and SPEC file revisions. Earlier destination settings confirmation is insufficient. A user edit returns to affected generation/review/scoring and requires fresh confirmation; do not alter content at submission.
completion_criteria: Every selected obligation is reconciled and, for export intent, actual content/upload confirmation matches the frozen current scored package. No confirm event is invented.

todo_list.content: Submit only the JSON path and verify backend operation results
todo_list.active_form: Exporting frozen JSON packages and recording backend persistence
instructions: Load ceaia-sdlc-jira-export only. Reuse current confirmation and handoff; no project/type/metadata queries, field partition, Markdown-to-wiki conversion, payload regeneration or generic-helper fallback at export. Read back the exact canonical JSON and scored SPECs; if changed, return upstream.

Actually call java-base-mcp.exportJiraByDynamicFields with exactly one argument: story_json_workspace_path copied unchanged from the passing score input. No other direct fields, staffId/conversationId, attachmentsJson/issuesJson, spec parameters or separate five-field association call. Batch selected files execute one at a time and stop further writes on failed/partial/unknown results.

The new backend validates the stored score/checksum/threshold, writes the ticket/attachments and owns database linkage plus sync queueing. Preserve the complete actual response and separate issue, attachment, database-link, queue and async Jira-score-sync evidence. A ticket key or generic success does not prove every effect. Confirmed synchronous submission may report Jira score synchronization pending; never claim asynchronous completion without evidence.

Unknown/partial results require supported reconciliation; never replay a successful ticket or upload to repair linkage/queue errors. Save eligible profile facts only from the actual upstream assembly snapshot after confirmed issue/required-attachment success, and report persistence separately. No actual returned evidence may be replaced by a fabricated success flag.
completion_criteria: Every intended synchronous issue/attachment/database-link/queue requirement has actual confirmation, or remains explicitly pending/unknown. Async Jira score synchronization is reported separately; no legacy B call is sent and no failed operation is hidden by a completed summary.

description: JSON-first CEAIA SDLC preview for GPT-5.6 Luna / GPT-6 Luna: query/assemble final Story JSON during generation, independently review JSON and Markdown SPEC, call scoreUserStory with JSON path and SPEC status/path, confirm the scored content, then export only the unchanged JSON path. Backend linkage/queue and async Jira score-sync outcomes remain separate.
